items.finding: ECUBE03 is a strict superset of ECUBE02 but is 17-26% FASTER per query in an interleaved same-window A/B (median -22.7%, range -26.0..-17.2%); ECUBE02 itself reproduces across two quiet windows (fixed 1.162 -> 1.152 us), so the delta is version-specific (recompile/code-layout), not drift. Cold startup identical (1.322 ms both). The +44 B NULL-count array has no measurable latency cost.
